title: Build convert.mjs and generate data/hikes.json
description:
tools/convert.mjs reads data/source/Local.csv and Database.csv and writes data/hikes.json in the Hike shape. Local supplies every Score input; Database adds lat, lon, months, tags, access joined on trail name (case-insensitive, trimmed). Decode Months / Trail Tags / Access Tags bitmasks to names. country = US when Local Restrictions contains USA. Keep When To Visit as notes. Do not store score.

Acceptance: hikes.json has every Local hike; unmatched names and field conflicts printed to stdout; Joffre Lakes months = [8, 9]; Echo Lake access = ["4x4", "Kayak"].

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, sections "Components > convert", "Data".

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Done: 64 hikes written. Joffre months [8,9], Echo access [4x4, Kayak]. 5 unmatched (Anniversary Glacier, Rainbow Pass, Camel Pass, The Gargoyles, Panorama Ridge), 10 conflicts reported, Local kept. Names title-cased.
